draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to the held-out customer-service domains evaluated (Insurance, Telecom and Utilities), where it achieves higher macro-F1 in each case.
rationale: T1.r3-r5 show Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains (85.7>81.2, 83.9>80.4, 86.2>82.0). The sentence's "may extend" is weaker than the evidence, which shows the advantage does extend to the evaluated held-out domains. No statistical test reported, so scope to the evaluated domains.
